newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Britons set to lose visa-free entry to Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Britons set to lose visa-free entry to Hong Kong.

text.p: The Hong Kong government said on Monday it was planning to strip British citizens of their visa-free right to reside and work in the British colony ahead of the handover to China next year.
More than 150 years of British rule ends at midnight on June 30 next year when Hong Kong reverts to China.

"After an internal review, the Government has concluded that changes should be in place before the change of sovereignty to remove the differences between British citizens and other foreign nationals regarding their immigration status," a government statement said.
Under the proposals, British citizens who come to Hong Kong to work, reside or study would need a visa, it said.
The statement said the proposals would be finalised by the end of the year and any changes would be made before the handover.
